_comment: SAMPLE STRUCTURE for the Book layer (Capa de Libro).
Every 'manifiesto' fragment is a real fragment of the 1605 original.
The 'original_1605' field is CONTENT: it is identical in every build,
in every language. It is never a translation key.
The 'modern' object holds one entry per language: a modernized
rendering that the player reads in their own language.
1. Source every fragment from a public-domain edition:
2. Always record the provenance in the 'source' block.
3. Set 'verified' to true only after a human checked it against the
edition. Unverified fragments must not ship.
4. If a PD translation of this passage exists in the player's
it goes in 'pd_translations' and the UI offers it as a third tab.
5. The 'modern' rendering must keep the RHYTHM and the strangeness.
A modernised Don Quixote is a different, and worse, book.

source.work: Miguel de Cervantes, Don Quijote de la Mancha, parte I, cap. VIII

original_1605: En un lugar de la Mancha, de cuyo nombre no quiero acordarme, no ha mucho tiempo que viviría un hidalgo de los de lanza en astillero, galera en coraza y bacía en el casco.

modern.es: En un lugar de la Mancha, de cuyo nombre no quiero acordarme, no hace mucho que vivía un hidalgo de los de lanza en astillero, galera en coraza y bacía en el casco.
modern.es_419: En un lugar de la Mancha, del que prefiero no acordarme, no hace mucho que vivía un hidalgo de los de lanza en astillero, galera en coraza y bacía en el casco.
modern.en: In a place in La Mancha, whose name I do not care to recall, there lived not long ago one of those gentlemen who are accustomed to a lance in the rack, a breastplate and a morion on the head.
modern.fr: En un lieu de la Manche, dont je ne veux pas me souvenir du nom, vivait naguère un gentilhomme de ceux qui portent lance au râtelier, cuirasse au corps et morion en tête.
modern.de: An einem Ort in der Mancha, dessen Namen ich nicht zu nennen begehre, lebte vor nicht langer Zeit einer von jenen Herren, die eine Lanze im Gestell, eine Brustplatte und einen Helm zu tragen pflegen.
modern.pt_BR: Em um lugar da Mancha, de cujo nome não quero lembrar-me, não vivia há muito tempo um fidalgo dos que usam lança no cabide, couraça no corpo e capacete na cabeça.

en.text: In a place in La Mancha, whose name I have no mind to remember, there dwelt not long since one of those gentlemen that are commonly called knights of the lance and buckler...

fr.text: En un lieu de la Manche, dont je ne veux pas me souvenir le nom, vivoit naguere un gentilhomme de ceux qui portent lance au râtelier...

variants.reality: La realidad: the plain is empty. The mill is a mill. (No text is shown; the scene speaks.)
variants.book: El libro: the mill is a giant. (The text is shown, with the Book layer's typography.)
